description: Sagittarius decan 2 (December 2 to December 11): personality, love, work and growth, with Mars as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Sagittarius.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Sagittarius covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly December 2 to December 11, with Mars as its sub-ruler beside Jupiter. It is read as adventurous conviction with a competitive, action-first edge. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Sagittarius decan 2 personality
paragraphs: In the middle ten degrees of Sagittarius, Mars steps in as sub-ruler. Mars is the ruler of Aries, so this decan adds fire to fire, sharpening the sign's restlessness into something more direct and combative. Natives are often described as bold, outspoken and physically energetic, the archer who would rather shoot than deliberate. They tend to act on their beliefs instead of merely discussing them. Sport, competition, debate and adventure in the literal sense, scaling mountains or setting off on unplanned journeys, frequently appeal. Where the first decan inspires with vision, this one tends to lead by charging ahead and inviting others to keep up.

The Martian influence brings courage and initiative, which are valuable whenever a situation needs someone willing to go first. It can also bring impatience, a short fuse and a tendency to argue a point long after it has been won. These Sagittarians may champion causes with real passion and become fierce defenders of people they believe are being treated unfairly. Their honesty is famously blunt. In older texts this decan is sometimes linked with strength and boldness, which still fits. When they channel that energy into worthwhile goals and learn to pause before reacting, their combination of daring and principle becomes genuinely formidable.

sections.heading: Sagittarius decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: In relationships, Mars's decan of Sagittarius tends to be passionate, playful and spontaneous. They often court with energy and enjoy partners who can match their pace, whether on a hiking trail or in a lively argument. Boredom is the enemy, and routine can feel suffocating. Their directness means you usually know where you stand. The difficulty comes when heated disagreements escalate faster than feelings can catch up. Learning to cool down before resolving a conflict, and showing tenderness as openly as enthusiasm, helps their partners feel secure as well as excited. Adventure shared in good faith keeps love fresh.

At work, this decan is drawn to action and challenge: entrepreneurship, sport, outdoor industries, emergency services, sales, campaigning, journalism and fields where quick decisions matter. They are often natural pioneers who would rather launch something new than maintain something old. Competition motivates rather than frightens them. Colleagues value their energy and candour, though their pace can leave slower teammates behind. Diplomacy is a learnable skill, and it pays off. Taking a moment to explain the reasoning behind a bold move, rather than just making it, tends to turn followers into genuine collaborators.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Sagittarius decan 2: what Mars adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Sagittarius, which in most years means birthdays from December 2 to December 11. Its sub-ruler, Mars, comes from Aries, the next fire sign after Sagittarius, so this decan borrows a little of Aries's character while staying Sagittarius at heart. The other two decans of Sagittarius belong to Jupiter (decan 1) and the Sun (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Mars adds drive, courage and a readiness to compete. A Mars decan is commonly read as more direct and physical, impatient with delay, energised by a challenge and willing to start fights that others would rather avoid. Martial decans are often linked with sport, competition, enterprise and protective instincts, and their usual lesson is to choose battles worth winning. Set against Sagittarius's optimism, curiosity, candour and a hunger for freedom, that Mars note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Sagittarius decan 2
paragraphs: Growth for this decan often centres on directing fire rather than spending it. Physical exercise is a traditional recommendation for Mars-heavy temperaments, giving restlessness a healthy outlet. A brief pause, even a single breath, before responding to provocation can change the course of a conversation. It may also help to choose battles deliberately, asking whether a debate serves a goal or merely satisfies the urge to win. Their courage is an asset worth protecting. When it is aimed carefully, it can open paths for others as well as themselves, turning personal daring into something constructive and shared.

Within Sagittarius, decan 1 leans towards expansive optimism and the hunger for meaning, undiluted and decan 3 leans towards visionary warmth with a flair for leadership and expression. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: How does Mars change the second decan of Sagittarius?
faq.answer: Mars, ruler of Aries, adds drive, competitiveness and directness to Sagittarius's optimism. Natives are often described as adventurous people of action who defend their beliefs energetically. The trade-off can be impatience and bluntness, which tend to ease with deliberate pauses.

faq.question: What are the dates of Sagittarius decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years December 2 to December 11, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Sagittarius. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Sagittarius decan 2?
faq.answer: Mars. In the triplicity system each fire sign's decans take the rulers of the fire signs in order, starting with Sagittarius's own ruler, Jupiter.
